title: v2: known speakers screen (enroll, list, delete)
description: UI to enroll a person by recording a 15-second voice sample, list enrolled people and delete them (goal 5).
steps: Create `ui/speakers/SpeakersViewModel.kt`: constructor `(repo: EnrolledSpeakerStore, enroll: EnrollSpeakerUseCase)`. State: `speakers` list (name, id), `enrollName`, `phase` (IDLE, RECORDING with progress, PROCESSING), `error`. `fun startEnrollment()` → `record(15_000)` then `enroll(name, samples)`; errors (IllegalArgumentException/IllegalStateException messages) go to `error`. `fun cancel()`, `fun delete(id)`.

Create `ui/speakers/SpeakersScreen.kt` (route `speakers`): explanation text "Record about 15 seconds of one person speaking normally. ConvoScribe will then recognise their voice in new recordings.", name field, "Record sample" button (requests RECORD_AUDIO like the record screen), a progress bar with seconds remaining while recording, "Processing…" state, and a list of enrolled names each with a delete icon + confirm dialog. If the embedding model is missing, show a button to go to `setup`.
Add a "Known speakers" row in `SettingsScreen` (Speakers section) navigating to `speakers`.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: successful enrollment returns to IDLE, clears the name, and the list contains the new name
Test: blank name sets error and does not start recording
Route `speakers` is reachable from Settings (visible in `SettingsScreen.kt` and `AppNavHost.kt`)
